heatmap_marked_only: Only chapters with a marked difference (●)
help_changepoints: Exact segmentation minimizes the documented cost with variance safeguards. Its proposed boundaries are candidates for review, not validated significance or evidence of narrative intent.
help_distribution_shift: Compares measurements in the earlier and later halves of the chapter sequence, not two halves of each chapter. Wasserstein distance describes the difference; the nominal KS p approximation assumes independent data. Ties and chapter ordering limit interpretation.
help_dlg_long_turns: Recognized spans with {min_words} or more words. Read extended monologues or explanatory passages in context.
help_dlg_short_turns: Share of recognized spans with 1–{max_words} words. Read the passage to see whether anyone is speaking.
help_dlg_voice_contrast: Words per sentence in recognized quotes and marked speech minus words per sentence in the unambiguous surrounding text. A negative value indicates shorter sentences in marked passages. The comparison needs usable sentences from both.
help_import_manuscript: Copies the selected manuscript bytes into a new project folder. Existing research records are not attached.
help_long_words: Share of counted words longer than the configured long-word threshold. This is one input to LIX, not the LIX score itself. Word length does not establish difficulty or quality.
help_open_existing: Opens an existing local project folder or manuscript in place, including its research archive. No files are copied.
help_pacing_cohesion: Share of adjacent sentence pairs in the same paragraph that share at least one content word.
help_pacing_hook: 0–3 heuristic: one point each for a closing sentence of 1–{max_words} words, terminal ?, ! or …, and detected quoted speech. This is not a validated suspense or quality measure.
help_pacing_monotony: Count of runs where {min_run} or more consecutive sentences in the same paragraph begin with the identical word. Marks candidates for either deliberate anaphora or unintended sentence-start monotony.
help_research_claim: A claim is your historical assertion or hypothesis. Lixity does not accept or verify it automatically.
help_research_comparison: Compares shared vocabulary, not factual agreement. Scores from different language profiles are not directly comparable.
help_research_confidence: You assign this evidence status. It is not a calculated probability or a verification result.
help_research_decision: Record a creative or historical choice and its rationale so readers can distinguish it from the source record.
help_research_deviation: Check this when you deliberately depart from the evidence. Leaving it unchecked does not certify factual accuracy.
help_research_dossier: A dossier holds your notes and optional passage references; it is not an accepted claim.
help_research_evidence: Link a retained passage to a claim and record how you interpret its relation. The link does not verify the claim.
help_research_ingest: Saving a source retains its bytes locally and indexes its passages. Confirm you have permission to keep a copy.
help_research_init: Creates a new local research archive for this project; it does not attach an existing archive.
help_research_passage: Find a retained passage in Research and choose Use for claim or dossier. Review the selected quotation before saving; selecting it alone saves nothing.
help_research_relation: Supports, contradicts, qualifies and contextualizes are your interpretations of the passage, not automatic judgments.
help_research_search: Search source passages and current dossiers, claims and decisions by words. Current does not mean verified or contradiction-free.
help_structural: Compare style features across chapters and between the two manuscript halves. Finding candidate changes requires a complete chapter series. Trends and half comparisons can use available values. Signals help you choose chapters to reread.
help_trends: Mann–Kendall describes whether a measurement tends to rise or fall across chapter order; this does not establish improvement or deterioration. Its nominal p approximation assumes independent observations. Ties and dependence between chapters limit interpretation.

site_export_network_error: The export request could not reach the application.
site_export_research: Include Research: authored entries, complete revision history and cited excerpts.
site_export_response_error: The export response could not be read as a valid ZIP.
site_export_sources: Also include retained original source files, full source text and media.
site_export_success: Download started. Unzip the ZIP and open index.html, or upload the folder to a website host.
site_export_transfer_error: The browser could not finish reading the export response.
site_preflight_large: Large package: consider a curated reader profile and fewer source files.
site_preflight_media: {references} media references: {unavailable} unavailable, {omitted} not packaged, {credits} with incomplete attribution. {ordinary} ordinary image links unchecked.
site_preflight_note: Counts include exported dossier revisions. Attribution is a presence check; mobile layout and rights are not verified. Nothing downloaded.
site_read_only: Read-only snapshot · Changes stay in the author’s local project.
site_research_hint: Saved entries and cited evidence. This snapshot does not update.
site_source_excerpts: Only cited excerpts are included. The full source text and original file are omitted.
speech_action_help: Record author voice, configure voice profiles, and direct narration.
speech_audit_compared: Compared with the supplied transcript. Recognizer mistakes are possible; this does not verify the spoken content.
speech_audit_hint: Inspect WAV, FLAC or MP3 locally. An optional timestamped transcript JSON is compared with the selected chapter or manuscript plan; no speech recognizer runs. Files are not added to the project.
speech_audit_more_results: Showing the first 100 entries. Download the full report for all entries.
speech_audit_ready: Audio audit ready. Measurements support listening review, not a quality verdict.
speech_audit_size_limit: Browser limit: 96 MiB for audio and 8 MiB for the transcript. Use the CLI for larger files.
speech_audit_unknown: Text comparison needs an expected plan and a timestamped transcript bound to this exact recording.
speech_banner_desc: Record a 15–25 second sample to narrate this book with your own natural author voice and timbre.
speech_base_direction_conflict: Qwen Base cannot use the text instructions in the passage direction. Remove those instructions or select 'Ignore passage direction' for this render. This also ignores passage voice assignments and pauses.
speech_cancelling: Cancellation pending; the current synthesis call may finish first.
speech_chapter_audio_hint: Import the complete selected chapter: mono/stereo 16-bit PCM WAV, 8–192 kHz, up to 48 MiB. It replaces this chapter’s previous recording for the reader export. The recording is bound to this manuscript revision; its spoken text is not verified.
speech_chapter_audio_missing: No chapter recording for this manuscript revision.
speech_chapter_audio_too_large: Choose a WAV up to 48 MiB. For larger files, use the audio-import command.
speech_controls_unsupported: This engine cannot use these controls. Clear them explicitly or choose a supporting engine.
speech_coqui_clear_instructions: Coqui cannot use text direction. Copy or clear these instructions before saving or changing profile.
speech_coqui_direction_conflict: Coqui cannot use passage text direction. Remove those instructions or ignore passage direction for this render; this also ignores passage voice assignments and pauses.
speech_coqui_runtime_hint: Coqui runs locally with its German Thorsten model; reference mode also needs local OpenVoice converter files. Install and start the matching worker before rendering. Completed chapter segments are saved locally; previews are always fresh.
speech_coqui_schema_required: Coqui profiles require audio schema /3. Back up and migrate this project before saving; see the Coqui setup guide.
speech_design_hint: Describe voice and accent. VoiceDesign generates each segment separately; even the same description can yield a different voice. Direction can also affect it. Listen to a short preview first; a matching worker is required.
speech_direction_context_changed: The project or manuscript changed. Copy your direction draft; saving and synthesis are disabled. Discard the draft to close.
speech_direction_coqui_hint: Coqui supports German synthesis and structural pauses, not free-text passage direction. You can ignore saved directions for one render; this also skips passage-specific voice assignments and pauses without deleting them.
speech_direction_hint: Delivery text is interpreted by the selected engine; its effect is not guaranteed. Pauses and structured controls are separate. Export retains authored direction.
speech_direction_provider_hint: Direct selected passages with voice assignments, delivery instructions and pauses. JSON retains these instructions. The external provider determines which controls it can render; SSML export explains unsupported or omitted controls.
speech_direction_save_first: Save or discard draft direction before rendering the chapter.
speech_direction_stale: Changed passages: review and remove outdated direction before rendering.
speech_direction_switch_first: Save or discard the direction draft before switching or closing.
speech_direction_unsaved: Draft direction: preview first; save to include it in the chapter.
speech_discard_help: Discard unsaved profile edits and restore the saved project settings.
speech_engine_reset: Engine changed: voice, speed and delivery instructions reset.
speech_engine_unavailable: No working bundled runtime is available for this engine. The saved profile remains available for plan export and cached audio. Choose a supported engine for new synthesis.
speech_export_hint: Preview the plan, then download JSON or SSML. No speech service is needed.
speech_export_limitations: JSON retains voice and direction metadata. SSML cannot guarantee how a provider interprets free-form direction. Absolute speech times remain unknown until audio exists.
speech_export_pronunciation_markup_unava: A pronunciation substitution cannot be represented reliably as SSML markup. The effective spoken text is exported; source details remain in the timeline.
speech_export_rate_is_advisory: SSML speaking rate is advisory and differs from an exact tempo adjustment after synthesis.
speech_export_ready: Plan ready. Download JSON or SSML for your speech system.
speech_export_source_provenance_unavaila: This segment has no retained source range from before pronunciation substitutions.
speech_export_ssml_unavailable: This plan could not be represented in SSML. JSON timeline export remains available.
speech_export_unsupported_instructions: Free-form delivery instructions remain in the JSON timeline; standard SSML cannot represent them faithfully.
speech_export_voice_binding_required: SSML voice names depend on the receiving engine. Map this speaker to a voice in that engine.
speech_first_preview: Preview: first bounded paragraph of the selected chapter
speech_ignore_direction: Ignore passage direction: drafts, assigned voices and passage pauses. Profile settings and default pauses still apply.
speech_ignore_help: Omit saved passage instructions, voice assignments and pauses for this render only. Saved direction stays unchanged.
speech_instructions_export_only: Free-text delivery is kept for plan export. This engine cannot apply it during synthesis. Clear the text before rendering or choose an engine that supports it; it is never silently ignored.
speech_jetson_hint: The selected text is processed on the configured Jetson through its SSH connection. Its worker must be connected before rendering. Completed segments can be reused; previews are always fresh.
speech_language_help: Choose the language spoken in the recording. Available synthesis languages depend on the model.
speech_listen_reference_help: Play this saved voice reference. This does not generate new speech.
speech_mic_busy: The microphone could not be opened. Check the device and other recording apps, then retry or upload a WAV.
speech_mic_failed: Recording could not start. Retry or upload a WAV.
speech_mic_missing: No microphone was found. Connect an input device and check the browser input selection, or upload a WAV.
speech_mic_permission: Microphone access was denied. In the address bar, open permissions for this local site, allow the microphone and retry. Also check system permissions. You can upload a WAV instead.
speech_mic_unavailable: Browser microphone capture is unavailable. Open Lixity at its local address in a supported browser, or upload a WAV.
speech_microphone_gain_read_only: This hardware range is read-only here. Change it in the system audio settings.
speech_microphone_gain_unknown: Hardware level unavailable for this device. Its mixer cannot be safely identified or controlled here.
speech_microphone_help: Adjusts server capture hardware (identified mixers only). Calibration measures input level; apply changes separately. Browser uses its own mic permission.
speech_model_base_hint: Use a saved recording and its exact transcript. Base does not accept text direction.
speech_model_clear_description: The voice description is only for VoiceDesign. Copy or clear it before saving or changing profile.
speech_model_clear_instructions: Base cannot use text direction. Copy or clear these instructions before saving or changing profile.
speech_model_clear_reference: This model does not use reference recordings. Clear the selection before saving or changing profile; the recording stays in the project.
speech_model_design_hint: Describe the voice and accent. Each segment is generated separately, so the voice may vary.
speech_model_need_description: Enter a voice description before changing profiles.
speech_model_need_reference: Choose a saved recording before changing profiles. Create or upload one in Author voice if needed.
speech_model_preset_hint: The presets can speak German; none lists German as its native language. Listen for accent and continuity.
speech_narrator_conflict: Read-aloud uses one narrator. A passage direction can change delivery, pauses and tempo, but not the voice. Choose a profile with the same voice; for a reference voice, use another delivery recording of the same speaker.
speech_pause_help: Silence in seconds between paragraphs or scenes. Saved passage direction can override these defaults.
speech_phonemes_error: Use at most 200 unique term=IPA lines (term: 100 characters; IPA: 300).
speech_phonemes_help: One term=IPA per line, for example Vogel=ˈfoːɡəl. Matches are case-sensitive whole words after spelling replacements. Only synthesis changes; the manuscript stays unchanged. Available only with a phoneme-capable engine.
speech_phonemes_schema_required: Review and apply the audio settings upgrade before adding phonetic or structured delivery controls.
speech_player_error: Audio could not be played. Check the recording and try again.
speech_player_spectrum_help: Live frequency levels, from low to high. This display is not a calibrated quality measurement.
speech_player_spectrum_unavailable: Frequency display unavailable; playback remains available.
speech_preview_help: Generate a fresh sample of the selected paragraph with the current voice profile. A matching speech service is required.
speech_profile_help: Choose the project voice profile used for synthesis. Save profile changes explicitly.
speech_profile_referenced: This profile is used by saved passage direction. Review or remove that direction first.
speech_profile_removed_draft: Profile removed from the draft. Save project audio settings to apply.
speech_profile_required: Choose or create a voice profile before exporting a plan or comparing a transcript.
speech_profiles_context_changed: The project or manuscript changed. Copy or discard your profile changes and reopen the project.
speech_profiles_unsaved: Save or discard profile changes first.
speech_pronunciation_bulk_special: Terms containing = are managed in the entry list above.
speech_pronunciation_context_changed: The project or manuscript changed. Copy or discard the entry draft and reopen the project.
speech_pronunciation_hint: One term=replacement per line. Only synthesis text changes.
speech_pronunciation_pending: Apply or discard the pronunciation entry first.
speech_prosody_default: Leave a field empty to use the model default shown. These controls shape delivery while retaining the reference voice.
speech_prosody_duration_scaling_factor_h: 1 keeps predicted durations. Above 1 lengthens speech; below 1 shortens it. This is model timing, separate from playback tempo.
speech_prosody_energy_variance_scale_hel: Scales variation in predicted speech energy. It shapes emphasis, not speaker volume or microphone gain.
speech_prosody_inherit: Empty fields inherit the voice profile. Set only the changes for this selected text range.
speech_prosody_pause_duration_scaling_fa: Scales pauses predicted inside this segment. Explicit silence before or after a passage remains separate.
speech_prosody_pitch_variance_scale_help: Scales pitch variation around the predicted contour. 1 keeps it, 0 flattens it. This does not set an absolute pitch or emotion.
speech_prosody_prosody_creativity_help: Controls variation in the model’s prosody sampling. Higher values allow more variation; they do not guarantee a particular emotion.
speech_provider_hint: Rendering sends the selected text to this endpoint. JSON/SSML export stays local. Enter the provider’s model and voice identifiers.
speech_provider_schema_required: Review and apply the audio settings upgrade before saving this provider.
speech_provider_status: Provider readiness is unknown here. Plan export needs no running speech engine.
speech_reader_help: Choose voices and direction, generate audio or export the plan.
speech_reader_help_plan: Choose voices and direction or export the plan.
speech_record_author_intro: Record a 15–25 second sample to serve as the voice clone reference for this book.
speech_record_empty: No audio was captured. Check the microphone and retry.
speech_record_help: Allow microphone access in the browser, then read naturally for about 15–25 seconds. Stop and listen before saving.
speech_record_ready: Recording ready. Listen and check the spoken text before saving.
speech_record_save: Save as author voice for this book
speech_record_save_help: Save this take and its exact spoken text as a project voice reference. Listen and check the transcript first.
speech_record_saved_not_active: Recording saved. The current voice profile was not changed. Select a profile that supports reference recordings to activate it.
speech_record_saved_success: Author voice successfully saved and activated.
speech_reference_empty: No recordings saved in this project yet.
speech_reference_hint: Choose a saved recording by its text and duration. Record or import one in Author voice. Reuse the same speaker’s recording to retain voice identity.
speech_reference_unavailable_help: The selected recording is missing or unreadable. Its assignment is retained. Choose another recording or restore it from the project backup.
speech_render_help: Generate audio for the selected chapter using the chosen service. Check the voice profile and direction before starting.
speech_reuse_help: Reuse compatible completed chapter segments. Disable to regenerate them. Paragraph previews are always generated afresh.
speech_runtime_hint: Rendering uses the selected engine and execution target. Check service readiness in Voice profiles. Preview first; finished chapter segments can be reused.
speech_save_help: Save the voice profiles and pronunciation replacements in this project. This does not start synthesis.
speech_schema_configuration_required: No voice is configured yet. Create an external voice profile for the project language after the upgrade.
speech_schema_default_profile: The implicit narrator becomes a saved profile.
speech_schema_hint: Review the proposed settings change before applying it. Existing audio settings stay unchanged until you apply.
speech_schema_ready: Audio settings upgrade ready for review.
speech_schema_review: Target: {schema}. Existing profiles retained: {count}. Applying first creates a verified settings backup outside the project.
speech_schema_review_one: Target: {schema}. Existing profile retained: {count}. Applying first creates a verified settings backup outside the project.
speech_selection_help: Choose the chapter or passage to direct, preview or export. Manuscript text stays unchanged.
speech_service_help: Inspect the configured model and reported residency. Choosing a profile does not start or switch a service.
speech_speed_hint: A factor of 1 keeps the synthesized pace. New profiles start at {default}. Pauses keep their length.
speech_speed_hint_model: The model uses this factor to shape the pace. New profiles start at {default}. The actual duration depends on the model. Pauses are set separately.
speech_take_confirmation: Review the actual spoken words and confirm the transcript before saving a voice reference. Editing the text clears this confirmation.
speech_take_confirmed: I checked that this transcript matches the recording
speech_take_context: This take belongs to the project and manuscript opened when it was recorded or imported. Reopen that context before saving.
speech_take_duration: The take remains available for listening. A voice reference must last 1–30 seconds; longer takes are not shortened automatically.
speech_take_export_failed: The take could not be exported. Check its transcript.
speech_take_format: Listening is available. Voice references require mono PCM WAV at 24 kHz and 16 bit; this take is not converted automatically.
speech_take_import_help: Select a PCM WAV and optionally its exported JSON sidecar. The sidecar verifies the audio and restores its transcript; without it, enter and confirm the spoken text below.
speech_take_invalid: The take could not be imported. Check the PCM WAV and its matching JSON metadata. The current take has been retained.
speech_take_loaded: Take loaded for review; nothing has been saved to the project.
speech_take_missing: Enter the words actually spoken in this recording.
speech_take_ready: Take and transcript checked. Save explicitly to add this voice reference to the project.
speech_take_transcript: A voice reference transcript may contain at most 2,000 characters. The imported text has been retained.
speech_target_scope: This choice is not saved in the profile.
speech_transcript_help: Enter the words actually spoken, including any departures from the sample text. No automatic transcription runs here.
speech_truncated: Preview shortened to the local preview limit.
speech_upload_help: Choose a WAV recording and enter exactly what was spoken. Uploading is an alternative to browser microphone capture.
speech_voice_changed: Language changed: choose a matching voice.
speech_voice_hint: Qwen uses preset voices. Choose delivery instructions explicitly.
speech_worker_match: Last checked: {target} · {model} matches the selected model. The worker may be busy or its state may have changed.
speech_worker_mismatch: Last checked: {target} runs {model}, not the selected model. Changing profiles does not switch the service. Qwen and Coqui share the local port. Select a matching profile or start the matching worker before rendering.
speech_worker_model_failed: Last checked: {target} · the {model} model failed during loading or rendering. Check the service log before retrying.
speech_worker_model_loaded: Last checked: {target} · the {model} model is loaded.
speech_worker_model_loading: Last checked: {target} · the {model} model is loading.
speech_worker_model_unloaded: Last checked: {target} · {model} is unloaded; it loads when rendering starts.
speech_worker_starting: Last checked: {target} is starting. Check again before rendering.
speech_worker_unavailable: Last checked: the worker on {target} was unavailable. Start a matching worker before rendering.
speech_worker_unknown: Worker status on {target} is unknown. Check again before rendering.
speech_zonos_runtime_hint: ZONOS3 runs in an isolated local MLX worker on Apple Silicon. A fixed voice or saved project reference is used; no text is sent to a hosted provider. The worker checks the runtime and model cache before reporting readiness.
status_refresh_error: Analysis could not be refreshed. Saved analysis is unchanged.
status_refresh_failed: Saved analysis shown. Analysis could not be refreshed.
status_source_missing: Saved analysis shown. The manuscript file is missing.
status_source_unreadable: Saved analysis shown. The manuscript could not be read.
structural_boundary_gap: Not calculated. Finding candidate changes requires a complete chapter series for each feature.
structural_guide: Compare style features between chapters, across the manuscript, and between its two halves.
structural_min_chapters: Requires at least 3 chapters for time-series changepoint and trend analysis.
structural_no_changepoints: No candidate boundaries selected with these settings; this does not establish stylistic stability.
structural_no_shifts: No nominal distribution signals selected between chapter halves; this does not establish equal distributions.
structural_no_trends: No nominal trend signals selected; this does not establish balanced rhythm or absence of stylistic change.
structural_partial_distribution: Some comparisons use only chapters with measurements; missing chapters are not represented.
structural_partial_trend: Some trends use only chapters with measurements; missing chapters are not represented.
structural_partly_unavailable: Some features could not be calculated because chapter measurements are missing or insufficient.
structural_selection_count: {selected} of {tested} tested features shortlisted for review.
structural_unavailable: Not enough comparable chapter measurements for this calculation.
style_pattern_dense_narrative: Dense narrative stretch (long sentences + low dialogue)
style_pattern_fast_dialogue: Brisk dialogue pace (short sentences + high dialogue)
style_tab_dimensions_help: Choose a chapter and compare its position with the other chapters.
style_tab_passport_help: Inspect overall style fingerprint, consistency score and dominant features.
style_tab_structural_help: Review possible style changes, trends, and differences between the two halves of the manuscript.
table_sort_help: Click to sort ascending or descending (Enter)
teleprompter_images_failed: Dossier images are unavailable. Reopen the teleprompter to try again.
teleprompter_images_suggested: Suggested by dossier title or tags
teleprompter_no_images: No dossier images linked to this passage.
teleprompter_plan_failed: Speech cues unavailable. Showing manuscript text without pronunciation or delivery cues. Review the audio plan, then reopen the teleprompter.
teleprompter_plan_ready: Saved speech projection: spelling replacements, IPA and range directions from the audio plan. The manuscript is unchanged.
teleprompter_take_context: The project has changed. Export this take and import it in the intended project.
teleprompter_take_denied: Microphone blocked. Allow microphone access in the browser site permissions, then try again.
teleprompter_take_export_failed: The take could not be exported. Check the transcript.
teleprompter_take_failed: Recording could not start. Check the microphone and try again.
teleprompter_take_help: Enter the words actually spoken. The reading script is not a confirmed transcript. Download WAV and JSON separately.
teleprompter_take_import_failed: Choose the matching WAV and JSON files. Invalid or mismatched files leave the previous take unchanged.
teleprompter_take_limit: Recording stopped at the file size limit. The take can be exported.
teleprompter_take_native_pending: Starting the microphone. Click again to cancel.
teleprompter_take_pending: Requesting microphone access. Allow it in your browser; click again to cancel.
teleprompter_take_play_failed: The recording could not be played.
teleprompter_take_running: Microphone recording is running. Click again to finish the take.
template_act_one_body: The ordinary world is established. An inciting incident forces the protagonist to make a fateful choice.
template_act_three_body: The climax, final showdown, and resolution bringing new perspective and transformation.
template_act_two_body: Rising obstacles, conflicts, and trials in an unfamiliar world leading to the crucial midpoint.
template_minimal_body: The story begins here. Write your opening lines or paste your manuscript content.
template_research_body: Every investigation begins with a question. The earliest accounts testify to events long kept in the shadows.
triage_author_guidance: Check whether this tense mix or switch is an intended stylistic choice (e.g. dialogue, scenic present, reflection) or an inadvertent shift in timeline.
triage_completed: {completed} / {total} reviewed decisions; deferred items stay open
triage_intro: In word-pattern analysis, tense hints can also match infinitives and auxiliaries. Quotations and retrospection may mix tenses. Review the context; these are hints, not confirmed errors.
triage_reason: Present markers: {present}; past markers: {past}. Mixed: {mixed}; switch from prior paragraph: {switch}. Heuristic pattern detection.
triage_saved: Decision saved. The manuscript is unchanged.
triage_storage: Review decisions are saved locally in this project. Changes anywhere in the manuscript or to analysis settings mean prior decisions need review.
triage_unavailable: Review state could not be confirmed. Reload or update analysis before retrying a save.
triage_unmatched: {count} previously saved decisions for this manuscript no longer match current passages; they are retained in the project.
triage_unmatched_one: {count} previously saved decision for this manuscript no longer matches a current passage; it is retained in the project.
welcome_config_desc: Choose and confirm the manuscript language in the preview before analysis.
welcome_desc: Start a new book project with a narrative structure or open an existing manuscript for stylistic analysis.
welcome_example: See a finished example on the documentation site
welcome_fdr_desc: Statistical shortlist for closer reading (nominal signals)
welcome_local: Work locally, from your manuscript to its passages.
welcome_manuscript_desc: Import a Markdown or text file, or open an existing project.
welcome_research: Read a passage behind a signal
welcome_research_desc: Start with a passage, compare chapters and inspect sentence rhythm. Decide what fits the scene and voice.
welcome_research_feature_desc: Full-text search, dossiers and evidence comparison
welcome_show_help: Show the introductory guide and workbench walkthrough.
welcome_style_desc: Chapter similarities from measured word and sentence patterns
wizard_author_hint: Used for PDF credits, the title page and the NDA. You can change it later in Project → Settings.
wizard_choose_location: Files on the computer running Lixity.
wizard_choose_unavailable: The folder could not be loaded. Try again or choose another folder.
wizard_drop_sub: or click to choose a file
wizard_folder_note: If omitted, a new folder is created from the title.
wizard_import_layout: Lixity saves the manuscript (manuscript.md) and project settings (lixity.toml) in a local folder.
wizard_intro: Create a local project from a manuscript or a new draft. Lixity writes only into the project folder; nothing is uploaded.
wizard_language_hint: Used for sentences, tense and readability. You can change it later.
wizard_open_note: Choose an existing project folder or manuscript file, or enter its path. Lixity opens it in place, including any research archive.
wizard_path_ambiguous_manuscript: This folder contains several possible manuscripts. Select the file you want inside the folder.
wizard_path_configured_manuscript_missin: The configured manuscript file could not be found. Select the file at its new location.
wizard_path_invalid: The path is invalid. Choose a folder or manuscript file.
wizard_path_manuscript_missing: No manuscript was found in this folder. Select the file you want directly.
wizard_path_missing: This path could not be found. Choose another folder or file.
wizard_path_unreadable: This folder or file cannot be read. Check its permissions or choose another path.
wizard_path_unsupported_type: Open a Markdown or plain text file. Use manuscript import for Word documents.
wizard_preview_estimate_hint: The analysis may count words and chapters differently.
wizard_project_files: Creates manuscript.md with the chosen chapter structure, lixity.toml and optionally research/.
wizard_research_template_desc: Includes a local research and dossier archive (research/).
wizard_switch_prompt: Want to import a new file instead?
workflow_compare_hint: Sentence length, speech share and style by chapter.
workflow_explore_hint: Sentence rhythm, scenes and recurring phrases.
workflow_review_hint: Find possible tense shifts in the text.
workspace_analysis_help: Manuscript text, editorial signals and continuous reading.
workspace_project_help: Project files, metadata, export and settings.
workspace_research_help: Dossiers, claims, sources and editorial decisions.
zotero_external_note: External Zotero catalogue; Lixity reads metadata and explicit captures only.
zotero_intro: Manage sources and media in Zotero. Capture selected text, PDF or PNG/JPEG sources here. Images remain visual references without OCR.
zotero_linked: Linked capture; file changes checked on update
zotero_media: Managed in Zotero; no text extraction here.
zotero_no_attachments: No capturable attachments under this entry.
zotero_note_hint: Zotero note: it stays in the external catalogue; only attachments can be captured.
zotero_tag_filter: Search the Zotero catalogue for this tag
zotero_type_help: Item type in the external Zotero catalogue. Lixity reads metadata and explicit captures only.
cmd_system_status_sub: Inspect local PDF/OCR, Zotero, audio workers and runtime status
desktop_env_note: Core manuscript analysis runs offline without optional extensions. External tools stay separate from the core app.
desktop_env_updates_desktop_only: Release checks are available in the Lixity Desktop app.
